title: aletes lithophila
intro: Aletes lithophila, commonly known as Western mountain-juniper, is a flowering plant species in the carrot family native to the mountainous regions of the western United States. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support respiratory health, act as an expectorant to relieve congestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Research on Aletes lithophila suggests that it contains bioactive constituents such as terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to support immune function and alleviate symptoms associated with colds and flu.
